what.line: British-Canadian computer scientist, co-inventor of the Boltzmann machine and champion of backpropagation, who left Google in 2023 to warn about the field he helped build

receipts.claim: AlexNet (Krizhevsky, Sutskever, Hinton) won ImageNet 2012 with 15.3% top-5 error against 26.2% for the runner-up, the moment deep learning took over

shared the 2018 ACM Turing Award, announced 2019-03-27, with Yann LeCun and Yoshua Bengio for deep learning
announced on 2023-05-01 that he had left Google after a decade so he could speak freely about AI risk
won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics with John Hopfield 'for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks'
told BBC Radio 4 in December 2024 he puts the chance of AI wiping out humanity within 30 years at 10 to 20 percent
